timing_boundaries: perf_counter around each adapter.featurize(text) and each singleton adapter.predict(features, threshold). Excludes reads/decompression, input construction, model fitting/loading, checks, and evidence writing. Training feature calls are timed separately around parser.featurize(text).
limitations: Local wall-clock measurements, not a worst-case guarantee for all QASM.
Three repeats, no discarded warmup calls. Fits and training parses precede benchmarks.
Only the public packet training fold is fitted; no validation scoring or audit access.
Circuit names and paths are joins/evidence only; no timing cache is an inference input.

training.fitting_policy: Every supplied training row; no benchmark/synthetic rows added
